tasks.short: Evaluate actual log characteristics and determine grades.

steps.what: Examine actual log characteristics and capture relevant grading observations
inputs: actual logs
actual established grading criteria

steps.what: Compare actual log characteristics with established criteria and decide the grade
inputs: actual log-characteristic observations
actual established grading criteria

steps.what: Enter the actual assigned grade and rationale using the log record's existing context

existing log identifier supplied with the actual log

tasks.design: Keep physical evaluation and grade determination with the grader. Use the native log record's stable identifier context for actual grade entry only; fresh observations, rationale, checking and ordinary save remain human.

tasks.enabler_now: Native records forms can retain an already selected log identifier.
tasks.still_hard: Defect significance and actual grade suitability remain contextual.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when an apparently ordinary feature materially changes the grade.
tasks.altitude: Retain actual grading and reduce repeated reference entry.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a log-linked records form can reuse a stable identifier without evaluating physical defects or determining grade.

tasks.short: Probe and inspect actual logs for defects and characteristics.

steps.what: Jab actual logs with the scale stick to assess physical condition
inputs: actual logs
actual scale stick

steps.what: Inspect actual logs for water damage, splits, knots, rot, twists and curves
inputs: actual probing observations
actual log surfaces and ends
outputs: actual identified physical characteristics and defects

tasks.design: Keep actual probing and physical defect inspection with the grader. A native tally form or reference view can record a finding but cannot perform these physical examinations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Condition is established by actual physical examination.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change performs these defined probing and inspection actions.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden damage and actual physical condition remain direct observations.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a superficial mark from a meaningful physical defect.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a tally form does not physically probe a log or inspect its actual condition.

assumptions: Shares60/40 are provisional, not measured. Record/write/report/send boundaries inspected: actual grade recording is separately mapped in task9811 and actual tree/load tally in9812; no second copy of those entries is hidden here. Any additional owned defect record must be split and assessed before this zero is used.
No photo pile measurement or machine volume file is claimed to detect these physical defects. No new sensor, robot or unassigned report baseline is proposed.
